 Clinching scenarios: How FC Cincinnati can lock in a playoff spot this weekend
 FC Cincinnati can clinch a playoff spot in several scenarios this weekend. 
 Prev 
 Next 
 With two matches left in the Major League Soccer regular season, FC Cincinnati is hoping to clinch a playoff spot this weekend, when they play Philadelphia. WCPO Sports Director Caleb Noe breaks down the playoff clinching scenarios. 
 By: 
 Caleb Noe 
 Posted 
 and last updated 
 Share Copy link Facebook Nextdoor X Threads Reddit LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Messenger Print 
 Add WCPO as a Google Preferred Source 
 CINCINNATI — With two games left in the Major League Soccer regular season, FC Cincinnati has a chance to clinch a playoff spot this weekend.
 The club has a home match against Philadelphia at TQL Stadium on Saturday at 2 p.m.
 It’s a “win and you’re in” scenario for FC Cincinnati, but there are other clinching scenarios, too:
 IF FC CINCINNATI WINS: 
… They’re in.
 IF FC CINCINNATI DRAWS, they need: 
… New York Red Bulls LOSS/DRAW
… Toronto FC LOSS/DRAW
… New York City LOSS/DRAW
 IF FC CINCINNATI LOSES, they need: 
… New York Red Bulls LOSS
… Toronto FC LOSS/DRAW
… New York City LOSS/DRAW
 A playoff appearance would mark the fifth consecutive year in the postseason for FC Cincinnati.
